sections.COMMENTS:
This Composite Source straddles the sector across the Engadine (to the west) and Tauern (to the east) tectonic windows just north of the Dolomites indenter and the Periadriatic Fault, in the eastern Alps between Italy and Austria.
Historical and instrumental catalogues (GrÃ¼nthal et al., 2009) show sparse yet moderate seismicity in this region. The main events in the area have occurred on 17 July 1670 (Mw 5.6) and on 22 December 1689 (Mw 5.3), affecting the whole Tirol region and the city of Innsbruck.
The strike and dip of this source were based on geological, seismological and geomorphological data. The rake represents normal dip-slip, inferred from seismological data. The minimum and maximum depth were in part inferred and in part based on seismological data. The slip rate was deduced from regional observations.
